summary: Armour Residential REIT filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a monthly cash dividend of $0.24 per common share for September 2026, with record date September 15, 2026 and payment date September 29, 2026. The filing includes the press release as Exhibit 99.1. This is a routine dividend declaration by a REIT, not a special situation. No deal terms, strategic actions, or unusual corporate events are present. The announcement is standard ongoing disclosure to maintain REIT tax status and reflects normal capital distribution activity.
